title: RiftBonk — Learn/Play Riftbound in Your Browser
author: devoniwits
selftext:
Riftbound is a complicated card game, so making a easier way to learn and play

It has practice matches, a guided tutorial, a Runeterra campaign, deck building, ranked play, and a leaderboard. The video shows those features and some of the card effects we’ve been working on.

One thing I learned: AI-generated artwork animated with code made a huge difference to the VFX compared with particles alone. The music is made with Suno, and the narration uses ElevenLabs.

Models used: Claude Fable, Codex Astra.

  
Try it: [https://riftbonk.com](https://riftbonk.com)  
Video: [https://youtu.be/JJ9qXH13F\_w](https://youtu.be/JJ9qXH13F_w)

Would love feedback on the gameplay and visuals. Happy to answer questions about how it was built!

*Unofficial fan project, not endorsed or sponsored by Riot Games.*

comments.author: SigniLume
comments.body: Honestly, as a learning tool, this is *really* well made! Kudos. I hope Riot doesn't give you trouble?
